headline: Redefine Properties Reports Higher Income and Lower Office Vacancy
summary: South African landlord Redefine Properties reported a 7.5% increase in distributable income, lower debt, and an office vacancy rate of 9.5%.
why: Property fund earnings and vacancy rates serve as key health indicators for commercial real estate markets and landlord balance sheets.

impacts.name: Redefine Properties
impacts.why: The company reported higher distributable income and lower debt.
